sourceSteps.sourceExcerpt: 第一步：假设结论不成立。
另一方面，由数列的单调性，0≤xᵢ≤u<1 (k<i≤n)。
对任意 1≤i≤k，由于 0≤xᵢ<1，且 m≥2，有 xᵢ^m≤xᵢ²。
对任意 k<i≤n，由于 0≤xᵢ≤u<1，m≥2，有 xᵢ^(m−1)≤xᵢ≤u。
两边乘以非负数 xᵢ，得 xᵢ^m≤uxᵢ。
当 n=k 时，上述两边均视为零，结论仍成立。

∑_{i=1}^n xᵢ^m
= ∑_{i=1}^k xᵢ^m + ∑_{i=k+1}^n xᵢ^m
≤ t−ku+ut + u∑_{i=k+1}^n xᵢ
= t−ku+u(t+∑_{i=k+1}^n xᵢ)
= t−ku+u∑_{i=1}^n xᵢ。
由题设 ∑_{i=1}^n xᵢ≤k，又 u≥0，所以 u∑_{i=1}^n xᵢ≤uk。
这与已知条件 ∑_{i=1}^n xᵢ^m≥1 矛盾。
因此原假设不成立，必有 ∑_{i=1}^k xᵢ≥1。证毕。

run.statement: ∀ (m n k : ℕ) (x : ℕ → ℝ), 0 < m → 0 < n → 0 < k → 2 ≤ m → 2 ≤ k → k ≤ n → (∀ i : ℕ, 1 ≤ i → i ≤ n → 0 ≤ x i) → (∀ i : ℕ, 1 ≤ i → i < n → x (i + 1) ≤ x i) → (∑ i in Finset.range n, (x (i + 1)) ^ m) ≥ 1 → (∑ i in Finset.range n, x (i + 1)) ≤ (k : ℝ) → (∑ i in Finset.range k, x (i + 1)) ≥ 1
run.proofTerm:
by
  intro m n k x hm hn hk hm2 hk2 hkn hnonneg hmono hsum_m hsum_le
  by_contra hgoal
  have source_step_0 : ¬ ((∑ i in Finset.range k, x (i + 1)) ≥ 1) := hgoal
  let t : ℝ := ∑ i in Finset.range k, x (i + 1)
  let u : ℝ := x k
  have source_step_1 : t < 1 := by
    dsimp [t]
    exact not_le.mp source_step_0
  have hkpos : 1 ≤ k := Nat.succ_le_of_lt hk
  have hdec : ∀ a b : ℕ, 1 ≤ a → a ≤ b → b ≤ n → x b ≤ x a := by
    intro a b ha hab hbn
    revert hbn
    induction b, hab using Nat.le_induction with
    | base =>
        intro hbn
        exact le_rfl
    | succ b hab ih =>
        intro hbn
        have hb1 : 1 ≤ b := le_trans ha hab
        have hbnlt : b < n := Nat.lt_of_succ_le hbn
        exact le_trans (hmono b hb1 hbnlt) (ih (le_of_lt hbnlt))
  have source_step_2 : 0 ≤ u ∧ (∀ i : ℕ, 1 ≤ i → i ≤ k → u ≤ x i ∧ x i ≤ t) ∧ t < 1 := by
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, source_step_1⟩
    · dsimp [u]
      exact hnonneg k hkpos hkn
    · intro i hi hik
      constructor
      · dsimp [u]
        exact hdec i k hi hik hkn
      · dsimp [t]
        have h_nonneg_terms : ∀ j ∈ Finset.range k, 0 ≤ x (j + 1) := by
          intro j hj
          have hjlt : j < k := Finset.mem_range.mp hj
          exact hnonneg (j + 1) (by omega) (by omega)
        have hi_mem : i - 1 ∈ Finset.range k := by
          rw [Finset.mem_range]
          omega
        have hsum := Finset.single_le_sum h_nonneg_terms hi_mem
        simpa [Nat.sub_add_cancel hi] using hsum
  have hu_lt_one : u < 1 := by
    have hu_le_t : u ≤ t := by
      have hxu : x k ≤ t := (source_step_2.2.1 k hkpos le_rfl).2
      simpa [u] using hxu
    exact lt_of_le_of_lt hu_le_t source_step_1
  have source_step_3 : ∀ i : ℕ, k < i → i ≤ n → 0 ≤ x i ∧ x i ≤ u ∧ x i < 1 := by
    intro i hki hin
    have hi1 : 1 ≤ i := by omega
    have hxi_nonneg : 0 ≤ x i := hnonneg i hi1 hin
    have hxi_le_u : x i ≤ u := by
      dsimp [u]
      exact hdec k i hkpos (le_of_lt hki) hin
    have hxi_lt_one : x i < 1 := lt_of_le_of_lt hxi_le_u hu_lt_one
    exact ⟨hxi_nonneg, hxi_le_u, hxi_lt_one⟩
  have source_step_4 : ∀ i : ℕ, 1 ≤ i → i ≤ k → (x i) ^ m ≤ (x i) ^ 2 := by
    intro i hi hik
    have hin : i ≤ n := le_trans hik hkn
    have hxnonneg : 0 ≤ x i := hnonneg i hi hin
    have hxi_le_t : x i ≤ t := (source_step_2.2.1 i hi hik).2
    have hxi_lt_one : x i < 1 := lt_of_le_of_lt hxi_le_t source_step_1
    have hxi_le_one : x i ≤ 1 := le_of_lt hxi_lt_one
    have hpow_le : (x i) ^ (m - 2) ≤ 1 := pow_le_one₀ hxnonneg hxi_le_one
    have hm_eq : m = 2 + (m - 2) := by omega
    calc
      (x i) ^ m = (x i) ^ (2 + (m - 2)) := by rw [hm_eq]
      _ = (x i) ^ 2 * (x i) ^ (m - 2) := by rw [pow_add]
      _ ≤ (x i) ^ 2 * 1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hpow_le (sq_nonneg (x i))
      _ = (x i) ^ 2 := by ring
  have source_step_5 : ∀ i : ℕ, 1 ≤ i → i ≤ k → 0 ≤ (x i - u) * (1 - x i) := by
    intro i hi hik
    have hle : u ≤ x i := (source_step_2.2.1 i hi hik).1
    have hxi_le_t : x i ≤ t := (source_step_2.2.1 i hi hik).2
    have hxi_lt_one : x i < 1 := lt_of_le_of_lt hxi_le_t source_step_1
    exact mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hle) (sub_nonneg.mpr (le_of_lt hxi_lt_one))
  have source_step_6 : ∀ i : ℕ, 1 ≤ i → i ≤ k → (x i) ^ 2 ≤ x i - u + u * x i := by
    intro i hi hik
    have hprod := source_step_5 i hi hik
    nlinarith [hprod]
  have source_step_7 : ∀ i : ℕ, 1 ≤ i → i ≤ k → (x i) ^ m ≤ x i - u + u * x i := by
    intro i hi hik
    exact le_trans (source_step_4 i hi hik) (source_step_6 i hi hik)
  have source_step_8 :
      (∑ i in Finset.range k, (x (i + 1)) ^ m) ≤
        (∑ i in Finset.range k, (x (i + 1) - u + u * x (i + 1))) := by
    apply Finset.sum_le_sum
    intro i hi
    have hi_lt : i < k := Finset.mem_range.mp hi
    have hi1 : 1 ≤ i + 1 := by omega
    have hik : i + 1 ≤ k := by omega
    exact source_step_7 (i + 1) hi1 hik
  have hsum_expr_eq :
      (∑ i in Finset.range k, (x (i + 1) - u + u * x (i + 1)))
        = t - (k : ℝ) * u + u * t := by
    dsimp [t]
    calc
      (∑ i in Finset.range k, (x (i + 1) - u + u * x (i + 1)))
          = (∑ i in Finset.range k, (x (i + 1) - u)) +
              (∑ i in Finset.range k, u * x (i + 1)) := by
              rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      _ = ((∑ i in Finset.range k, x (i + 1)) - (∑ i in Finset.range k, u)) +
              (∑ i in Finset.range k, u * x (i + 1)) := by
              rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
      _ = ((∑ i in Finset.range k, x (i + 1)) - (k : ℝ) * u) +
              u * (∑ i in Finset.range k, x (i + 1)) := by
              have hconst : (∑ i in Finset.range k, u) = (k : ℝ) * u := by
                rw [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_range]
                simp
              have hmul : (∑ i in Finset.range k, u * x (i + 1)) =
                    u * (∑ i in Finset.range k, x (i + 1)) := by
                rw [Finset.mul_sum]
              rw [hconst, hmul]
  have source_step_9 :
      (∑ i in Finset.range k, (x (i + 1)) ^ m) ≤ t - (k : ℝ) * u + u * t := by
    exact le_trans source_step_8 (le_of_eq hsum_expr_eq)
  have source_step_10 : ∀ i : ℕ, k < i → i ≤ n →
      ((x i) ^ (m - 1) ≤ x i) ∧ x i ≤ u ∧ x i < 1 := by
    intro i hki hin
    have hbase := source_step_3 i hki hin
    have hxnonneg : 0 ≤ x i := hbase.1
    have hxi_le_u : x i ≤ u := hbase.2.1
    have hxi_lt_one : x i < 1 := hbase.2.2
    have hxi_le_one : x i ≤ 1 := le_of_lt hxi_lt_one
    have hm1_eq : m - 1 = 1 + ((m - 1) - 1) := by omega
    have hpow_le : (x i) ^ ((m - 1) - 1) ≤ 1 := pow_le_one₀ hxnonneg hxi_le_one
    have hpow_le_x : (x i) ^ (m - 1) ≤ x i := by
      calc
        (x i) ^ (m - 1) = (x i) ^ (1 + ((m - 1) - 1)) := by rw [hm1_eq]
        _ = (x i) ^ 1 * (x i) ^ ((m - 1) - 1) := by rw [pow_add]
        _ ≤ (x i) * 1 := by
             simpa [pow_one] using (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hpow_le hxnonneg)
        _ = x i := by ring
    exact ⟨hpow_le_x, hxi_le_u, hxi_lt_one⟩
  have source_step_11 : ∀ i : ℕ, k < i → i ≤ n → (x i) ^ m ≤ u * x i := by
    intro i hki hin
    have hbase10 := source_step_10 i hki hin
    have hxnonneg : 0 ≤ x i := (source_step_3 i hki hin).1
    have hpow_le_u : (x i) ^ (m - 1) ≤ u := le_trans hbase10.1 hbase10.2.1
    have hm_eq : m = (m - 1) + 1 := by omega
    calc
      (x i) ^ m = (x i) ^ ((m - 1) + 1) := by rw [hm_eq]
      _ = (x i) ^ (m - 1) * x i := by rw [pow_succ]
      _ ≤ u * x i := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hpow_le_u hxnonneg
  have source_step_12 :
      (∑ i in Finset.range (n - k), (x (k + i + 1)) ^ m) ≤
        u * (∑ i in Finset.range (n - k), x (k + i + 1)) := by
    calc
      (∑ i in Finset.range (n - k), (x (k + i + 1)) ^ m)
          ≤ (∑ i in Finset.range (n - k), u * x (k + i + 1)) := by
              apply Finset.sum_le_sum
              intro i hi
              have hi_lt : i < n - k := Finset.mem_range.mp hi
              have hki : k < k + i + 1 := by omega
              have hin : k + i + 1 ≤ n := by omega
              exact source_step_11 (k + i + 1) hki hin
      _ = u * (∑ i in Finset.range (n - k), x (k + i + 1)) := by
              rw [Finset.mul_sum]
  have source_step_13 : n = k →
      (∑ i in Finset.range (n - k), (x (k + i + 1)) ^ m) = 0 ∧
      (∑ i in Finset.range (n - k), x (k + i + 1)) = 0 := by
    intro hnk
    have hzero : n - k = 0 := by omega
    simp [hzero]
  have hpower_split :
      (∑ i in Finset.range n, (x (i + 1)) ^ m) =
        (∑ i in Finset.range k, (x (i + 1)) ^ m) +
        (∑ i in Finset.range (n - k), (x (k + i + 1)) ^ m) := by
    have hsplit : n = k + (n - k) := by omega
    calc
      (∑ i in Finset.range n, (x (i + 1)) ^ m)
          = ∑ i in Finset.range (k + (n - k)), (x (i + 1)) ^ m := by
              conv_lhs => rw [hsplit]
      _ = (∑ i in Finset.range k, (x (i + 1)) ^ m) +
          (∑ i in Finset.range (n - k), (x (k + i + 1)) ^ m) := by
              rw [Finset.sum_range_add]
              simp [Nat.add_comm, Nat.add_left_comm, Nat.add_assoc]
  have hx_split :
      (∑ i in Finset.range n, x (i + 1)) =
        t + (∑ i in Finset.range (n - k), x (k + i + 1)) := by
    dsimp [t]
    have hsplit : n = k + (n - k) := by omega
    calc
      (∑ i in Finset.range n, x (i + 1))
          = ∑ i in Finset.range (k + (n - k)), x (i + 1) := by
              conv_lhs => rw [hsplit]
      _ = (∑ i in Finset.range k, x (i + 1)) +
          (∑ i in Finset.range (n - k), x (k + i + 1)) := by
              rw [Finset.sum_range_add]
              simp [Nat.add_comm, Nat.add_left_comm, Nat.add_assoc]
  have source_step_14 :
      (∑ i in Finset.range n, (x (i + 1)) ^ m) ≤
        t - (k : ℝ) * u + u * (∑ i in Finset.range n, x (i + 1)) := by
    calc
      (∑ i in Finset.range n, (x (i + 1)) ^ m)
          = (∑ i in Finset.range k, (x (i + 1)) ^ m) +
            (∑ i in Finset.range (n - k), (x (k + i + 1)) ^ m) := hpower_split
      _ ≤ (t - (k : ℝ) * u + u * t) +
            u * (∑ i in Finset.range (n - k), x (k + i + 1)) := by
              exact add_le_add source_step_9 source_step_12
      _ = t - (k : ℝ) * u + u * (t + ∑ i in Finset.range (n - k), x (k + i + 1)) := by ring
      _ = t - (k : ℝ) * u + u * (∑ i in Finset.range n, x (i + 1)) := by
            rw [← hx_split]
  have source_step_15 :
      u * (∑ i in Finset.range n, x (i + 1)) ≤ u * (k : ℝ) := by
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsum_le source_step_2.1
  have source_step_16 :
      (∑ i in Finset.range n, (x (i + 1)) ^ m) < 1 := by
    calc
      (∑ i in Finset.range n, (x (i + 1)) ^ m)
          ≤ t - (k : ℝ) * u + u * (∑ i in Finset.range n, x (i + 1)) := source_step_14
      _ ≤ t - (k : ℝ) * u + u * (k : ℝ) := by
            exact add_le_add_left source_step_15 (t - (k : ℝ) * u)
      _ = t := by ring
      _ < 1 := source_step_1
  have source_step_17 : False := by
    have hge : 1 ≤ (∑ i in Finset.range n, (x (i + 1)) ^ m) := hsum_m
    linarith
  have source_step_18 : (∑ i in Finset.range k, x (i + 1)) ≥ 1 := by
    exfalso
    exact source_step_17
  exact source_step_17

originalGivenExcerpts: 设 m,n,k 均为正整数，满足 m≥2，n≥k≥2。
已知非负实数 x₁≥x₂≥⋯≥xₙ≥0 满足 ∑_{i=1}^n xᵢ^m≥1 及 ∑_{i=1}^n xᵢ≤k。

【待验证题目｜本聊天上一条助理给出的证明，未改写推理，不将其身份当作官方参考答案】
设 m,n,k 均为正整数，满足 m≥2，n≥k≥2。已知非负实数 x₁≥x₂≥⋯≥xₙ≥0 满足 ∑_{i=1}^n xᵢ^m≥1 及 ∑_{i=1}^n xᵢ≤k。求证 ∑_{i=1}^k xᵢ≥1。

【原证明】
第一步：假设结论不成立。
假设 ∑_{i=1}^k xᵢ<1。记 t=∑_{i=1}^k xᵢ，u=xₖ。
由条件可知 0≤u≤xᵢ≤t<1 (1≤i≤k)。
另一方面，由数列的单调性，0≤xᵢ≤u<1 (k<i≤n)。

第二步：估计前 k 项的 m 次幂。
对任意 1≤i≤k，由于 0≤xᵢ<1，且 m≥2，有 xᵢ^m≤xᵢ²。
又因为 u≤xᵢ<1，所以 (xᵢ−u)(1−xᵢ)≥0。
展开并整理，得 xᵢ²≤xᵢ−u+uxᵢ。
因此 xᵢ^m≤xᵢ−u+uxᵢ。
对 i=1,2,…,k 求和，得到
∑_{i=1}^k xᵢ^m ≤ ∑_{i=1}^k (xᵢ−u+uxᵢ) = t−ku+ut。

第三步：估计后 n−k 项的 m 次幂。
对任意 k<i≤n，由于 0≤xᵢ≤u<1，m≥2，有 xᵢ^(m−1)≤xᵢ≤u。
两边乘以非负数 xᵢ，得 xᵢ^m≤uxᵢ。
故 ∑_{i=k+1}^n xᵢ^m ≤ u∑_{i=k+1}^n xᵢ。
当 n=k 时，上述两边均视为零，结论仍成立。

第四步：合并两个估计。
将前后两部分相加：
∑_{i=1}^n xᵢ^m
= ∑_{i=1}^k xᵢ^m + ∑_{i=k+1}^n xᵢ^m
≤ t−ku+ut + u∑_{i=k+1}^n xᵢ
= t−ku+u(t+∑_{i=k+1}^n xᵢ)
= t−ku+u∑_{i=1}^n xᵢ。

第五步：利用已知条件推出矛盾。
由题设 ∑_{i=1}^n xᵢ≤k，又 u≥0，所以 u∑_{i=1}^n xᵢ≤uk。
代入上式：
∑_{i=1}^n xᵢ^m≤t−ku+u∑_{i=1}^n xᵢ≤t−ku+uk=t<1。
这与已知条件 ∑_{i=1}^n xᵢ^m≥1 矛盾。
因此原假设不成立，必有 ∑_{i=1}^k xᵢ≥1。证毕。

第四步：合并两个估计。
将前后两部分相加：
∑_{i=1}^n xᵢ^m
= ∑_{i=1}^k xᵢ^m + ∑_{i=k+1}^n xᵢ^m
≤ t−ku+ut + u∑_{i=k+1}^n xᵢ
= t−ku+u(t+∑_{i=k+1}^n xᵢ)
= t−ku+u∑_{i=1}^n xᵢ。

第五步：利用已知条件推出矛盾。
由题设 ∑_{i=1}^n xᵢ≤k，又 u≥0，所以 u∑_{i=1}^n xᵢ≤uk。
代入上式：
∑_{i=1}^n xᵢ^m≤t−ku+u∑_{i=1}^n xᵢ≤t−ku+uk=t<1。
这与已知条件 ∑_{i=1}^n xᵢ^m≥1 矛盾。
因此原假设不成立，必有 ∑_{i=1}^k xᵢ≥1。证毕。

【待验证题目｜本聊天上一条助理给出的证明，未改写推理，不将其身份当作官方参考答案】
设 m,n,k 均为正整数，满足 m≥2，n≥k≥2。已知非负实数 x₁≥x₂≥⋯≥xₙ≥0 满足 ∑_{i=1}^n xᵢ^m≥1 及 ∑_{i=1}^n xᵢ≤k。求证 ∑_{i=1}^k xᵢ≥1。

【原证明】
第一步：假设结论不成立。
假设 ∑_{i=1}^k xᵢ<1。记 t=∑_{i=1}^k xᵢ，u=xₖ。
由条件可知 0≤u≤xᵢ≤t<1 (1≤i≤k)。
另一方面，由数列的单调性，0≤xᵢ≤u<1 (k<i≤n)。

第二步：估计前 k 项的 m 次幂。
对任意 1≤i≤k，由于 0≤xᵢ<1，且 m≥2，有 xᵢ^m≤xᵢ²。
又因为 u≤xᵢ<1，所以 (xᵢ−u)(1−xᵢ)≥0。
展开并整理，得 xᵢ²≤xᵢ−u+uxᵢ。
因此 xᵢ^m≤xᵢ−u+uxᵢ。
对 i=1,2,…,k 求和，得到
∑_{i=1}^k xᵢ^m ≤ ∑_{i=1}^k (xᵢ−u+uxᵢ) = t−ku+ut。

第三步：估计后 n−k 项的 m 次幂。
对任意 k<i≤n，由于 0≤xᵢ≤u<1，m≥2，有 xᵢ^(m−1)≤xᵢ≤u。
两边乘以非负数 xᵢ，得 xᵢ^m≤uxᵢ。
故 ∑_{i=k+1}^n xᵢ^m ≤ u∑_{i=k+1}^n xᵢ。
当 n=k 时，上述两边均视为零，结论仍成立。

第四步：合并两个估计。
将前后两部分相加：
∑_{i=1}^n xᵢ^m
= ∑_{i=1}^k xᵢ^m + ∑_{i=k+1}^n xᵢ^m
≤ t−ku+ut + u∑_{i=k+1}^n xᵢ
= t−ku+u(t+∑_{i=k+1}^n xᵢ)
= t−ku+u∑_{i=1}^n xᵢ。

第五步：利用已知条件推出矛盾。
由题设 ∑_{i=1}^n xᵢ≤k，又 u≥0，所以 u∑_{i=1}^n xᵢ≤uk。
代入上式：
∑_{i=1}^n xᵢ^m≤t−ku+u∑_{i=1}^n xᵢ≤t−ku+uk=t<1。
这与已知条件 ∑_{i=1}^n xᵢ^m≥1 矛盾。
因此原假设不成立，必有 ∑_{i=1}^k xᵢ≥1。证毕。
